assignment: Preserve dictionary insertion order in pytest assertion failure output instead of alphabetically sorting keys.

required_outcomes.text: Dictionary keys in assertion failure output preserve insertion order.
Safe dictionary representation preserves insertion order.

invariants.text: Dictionary truncation keeps insertion order and appends the existing ... fill value.
Dictionary representation remains safe when key or value repr raises.
Assertion outcome accounting retains the same passed, skipped, and failed semantics.

non_goals.text: Do not change ordering behavior for non-dictionary collections.
Do not change truncation limits or ellipsis formatting.
Do not weaken exception handling for unsafe representations.
Do not change assertion result accounting.
Do not broaden the change into an unrelated pretty-printer refactor.
